text:
marta: Heads up — noticed in staging that after we changed the support_agent role the routing policy still applied the old quota on some routes.
kevin: uh oh. do you have a quick repro?
marta: yeah — patched role->scope mapping at 14:20, console shows new scope immediately, but route metrics/quotas still reflect old entitlements for ~3m.
jasper: is this the authz-cache TTL we set in authz-service? last i checked it was 180s.
sam: i thought we lowered it to 60s on dedicated clusters for perf last week.
marta: it seems authz-cache never got invalidated on the binding change. our rolebindings API emits user events but not rolebinding events to the event bus.
carla: we should emit an "entitlement.version" on every RBAC mutation (roles, bindings, service accounts). router can compare versions and re-eval.
kevin: api design question: should the runtime call introspect per-request, or keep cached perms and listen for events? per-request introspect hurts latency.
jasper: agreed — per-request introspect is a non-starter for p50/p99. prefer event-driven invalidation + light-weight token hints.
sam: one compromise: include `ent_version` in token introspection so router can do cheap check: if token.ent_version < local.ent_version -> refresh cache.
marta: prototype i used in staging:

```
POST /v1/introspect
{ "token": "abc" }
-> { "active": true, "scopes": ["route:read"], "ent_version": "2026-03-21T14:20:00Z" }
```
router compares ent_version to cached value and only pulls detailed perms when needed.
carla: +1. also add telemetry: emit `authz.stale_eval.count` when router falls back due to stale perms and `perm_version_skew_ms` histogram.
kevin: ux ask: in console display an "effective permissions" diff for admins after a change (show what routing/quotas will change). customers got confused when grants applied but routing didn't follow for a few minutes.
marta: we could surface a small diff banner for 15m after a change and include an estimated impact (sampled traffic). helps with canaries.
sam: implementation notes: rbac mutations -> `rbac.events` topic with payload {type: role|binding|sa, id, ent_version: ts}. router subscribes and bumps local ent_version.
jasper: small api debate: ent_version as ISO timestamp vs monotonic int. timestamps are human-friendly but prone to clock skew across regions.
carla: prefer ISO timestamp + server-side monotonic counter appended, e.g. `2026-03-21T14:20:00Z#42` so comparisons are stable.
kevin: action items: jasper -> add ent_version to /introspect (authz svc). sam -> wire rbac.events -> router subscription. carla -> add metrics + a dashboard heatmap widget for stale-eval by route. marta -> mock the console diff UI for PM review and staging canary.
marta: canary target: staging internal only this week. i'll post the patch and test plan tonight. :thumbsup:
auth-bot: deploy scheduled: canary/rbac-ent-version v1 -> staging at 22:00 UTC. watch `authz.stale_eval.count` and `perm_version_skew_ms` metrics.
kevin: thanks all. if we catch any surprising fallout we rollback the canary and revert event emission.
marta: i'll run an adhoc script to replay rolebinding events after deploy to validate invalidations.
kevin: perfect — keep thread updated, and add brief notes to the rollouts doc (link: https://redwood/ops/rollouts/rbac-ent-version).
